active_mass.quote: CUORICINO is an array of 62 tellurium oxide (T eO2 ) bolometers with an active mass of 40.7 kg.

isotope.quote: CUORICINO [12] was a tower array of 62 TeO2 crystals used as bolometric detectors.

temperature.quote: CUORICINO is operated at a temperature of ∼8 mK with a spread of ∼1 mK

summary.plain: Sixty-two crystals of tellurium oxide stacked in thirteen layers. A decay inside a crystal warms it by a hair's breadth, and a thermistor on each crystal records the temperature pulse.
summary.technical: 13 planes of 62 TeO2 bolometers (44 cubes of 5 cm and 18 of 3x3x6 cm), 40.7 kg active mass, NTD thermistors, ~8 mK base temperature, dilution refrigerator shielded against radioactivity and neutrons.

technology.quote: CUORICINO [12] was a tower array of 62 TeO2 crystals used as bolometric detectors.
technology.value: A tower of TeO2 crystals used as cryogenic bolometers, cooled in a dilution refrigerator and read out by neutron-transmutation-doped thermistors
